_help: site.json = how the site behaves: the menu bar, which pages are switched on, the game mode cards and the homepage extras (live numbers, live chat). The store itself is in store.json; the server name, IP and Discord link are in config.json.
_floatingNavbarHelp: true = the top navbar floats over the page as a rounded bar. false = normal sticky navbar.
_enableStoreButtonHelp: true = shows the Store button in the navbar. false = hides it.

pages._help: Turn whole pages on or off. A page that is off disappears from every menu and link.

_gameModesHelp: Which game-mode cards show in the Server features section on the homepage. Available: survival, lifesteal, ffa, economy.

hero._help: 'liveStats' shows the player and Discord counters under the IP box. Set it or the 'discord' block to false to hide that piece.

discord._help: Live Discord member count. It uses the Discord link from config.json - leave inviteCode empty to use that link, or paste just the invite code (e.g. S763GafZPR) to use a different invite.

liveChat._help: The live chat card on the homepage. It reads secret.json (plugin URL + secret) and shows live Minecraft chat, players online and server uptime. Set enabled to false to hide the card.
liveChat.title: Live chat
liveChat.subtitle: What players are saying in-game right now, refreshed automatically.
